capability: A vertex-area stress diagnostic demonstrates the unsigned-distance leniency mechanism
why_this_matters: runner.py records that unsigned distance is lenient and leaves it open. This diagnostic demonstrates that mechanism, but its vertex-area weighting is not the committed per-triangle fabricated_area_fraction instrument and does not numerically rescore accepted evidence.
acceptance_was_fixed_before_measuring: program/claims/open3d-signed-fabrication-measure/CLAIM.md, written first: the leniency has to reproduce, a stricter measure has to catch the bridge, and both have to agree a genuinely faithful reconstruction is faithful. A measure that catches the bridge by also condemning good surface has improved nothing.

the_first_construction_failed_and_is_kep.what_it_was: A torus with a disc capping its central hole.
the_first_construction_failed_and_is_kep.what_happened: The current measure scored it at 0.2576 fabricated, which is exactly the disc's area share. It caught it perfectly.
the_first_construction_failed_and_is_kep.why_the_reasoning_was_wrong: A disc spanning the hole is only near the inner tube wall at its rim; its middle is most of a torus-radius from anything. I had asserted the opposite in the docstring before running it.
the_first_construction_failed_and_is_kep.why_it_is_still_in_the_file: A construction that fails to exercise an effect is not evidence the effect is absent. Deleting it would leave the record implying the second construction was the first idea.

the_leniency_reproduces.construction: Two unit boxes one voxel apart. Poisson fuses them across the gap on its own, so the bridge is the real failure mode rather than a surface added by hand.
the_leniency_reproduces.reading: The vertex-area unsigned-distance diagnostic reads exactly zero on a mesh where surface spans a gap the reference has nothing in. This demonstrates the mechanism; it is not the committed per-triangle instrument's numeric reading.

signed_distance_was_the_obvious_fix_and_.result: Identical to the unsigned reading in all ten cases, to the digit.
signed_distance_was_the_obvious_fix_and_.why_not_what_i_assumed: I expected it to be inapplicable because a bridge sits in free space. In fact surface inside the reference does exist in the comb cases, up to 12.9 percent of the area -- but every point of it is also more than a voxel away, so the inside set is a subset of the far set the unsigned measure already had. Redundant, not inapplicable, which is a stronger statement. My own test caught the assumption.

normal_correspondence_is_the_one_that_wo.definition: A reconstructed point counts as corresponding to the reference only if its own normal agrees with the reference normal at the point it is nearest to, within 60 degrees.
normal_correspondence_is_the_one_that_wo.why_the_cutoff_is_permissive_on_purpose: Poisson normals on correct surface wander by a degree or two and the bridges this catches are near-perpendicular, so nothing sits close to the cutoff. Median disagreement on the faithful control is 0.509 degrees.
normal_correspondence_is_the_one_that_wo.the_control_is_the_hard_case: A single box reconstructed the same way. Poisson rounds its sharp edges, which is exactly where a normal-based test would be expected to misfire, and it does not.

the_vertex_area_diagnostic_crosses_the_t.worked_example: At 13 closed gaps the diagnostic reads 0.0345 unsigned and 0.1227 with normal correspondence, crossing 0.05 under this proxy.
the_vertex_area_diagnostic_crosses_the_t.largest_ratio_in_this_proxy: 32-fold, at 7 gaps: 0.0013 against 0.0418. This is not an exact understatement factor for the committed per-triangle instrument.
the_vertex_area_diagnostic_crosses_the_t.robust_to_the_nondeterminism: The diagnostic band [9, 11, 13] reproduced across independent runs; it remains synthetic proxy evidence, not an accepted-evidence rescore.

which_way_the_proxy_bias_runs: Under this vertex-area proxy, the unsigned reading can sit below 0.05 while normal correspondence sits above it. That shows the possible bias direction but does not prove any committed band-validity row was misclassified.
what_this_does_not_claim: That any committed conclusion is wrong, that the proxy's shares are readings of the committed per-triangle instrument, or that its 32-fold ratio and [9, 11, 13] band transfer numerically. The synthetic construction demonstrates the leniency mechanism and motivates a true instrument-matched rescore.
nothing_gates_on_this: fabricated_area_fraction is a validation instrument used by the evidence harnesses, not a product gate. No shipped behaviour changes here, and this adds a harness and a report rather than touching npa/src.

tests.what_count_means: collected test cases, not test functions
tests.note: Pinned from the committed report, because the harness needs Open3D and the sample geometry and CI has neither. Conclusions pinned exactly, the four least-significant figures with tolerances, since Poisson is nondeterministic.

visual_evaluation.reason: No renderable artifact. The result is a table of area fractions under four definitions, and the evidence that it is right is a control that stays at 0.0001 while the test case moves to 0.0046.
